title: Why Everyone’s Talking About AI (Again)
content: AI isn’t just hype anymore — it’s showing up in your phone, your work tools, and even your fridge. From ChatGPT writing your emails to smart assistants managing your calendar, AI is becoming the sidekick you didn’t know you needed. The best part? You don’t need to be a coder to use it. Just ask, and it delivers. Whether it’s helping you write blogs (like this one!) or recommending dinner, AI is here — and it’s getting smarter fast. Buckle up.
